proposals.workingTitle: Typhoon Power Cuts: Keeping Phones and Lights Going for 72 Hours
proposals.brief: A practical guide for Filipino households on staying powered through a multi-day typhoon outage — sizing a power station, rationing phone charge, safe lantern use, and what to buy before the storm.
proposals.summary: How to keep essential devices and lights running for three days without grid power.

proposals.workingTitle: Best Portable Power Stations for Brownouts (2026)
proposals.brief: Roundup review of portable power stations suited to Philippine brownouts: capacity vs price, recharge options, and which model fits a small household.

proposals.workingTitle: Flood-Ready Documents: Waterproofing IDs, Cash and Papers
proposals.brief: How to protect IDs, land titles, cash and medical records before a flood — dry bags, lamin­ation, cloud backups and a grab-and-go document pouch.
proposals.heroImageBrief: A clean flat illustration (not a photo) of a waterproof document pouch with IDs and papers sealed inside, water beading off it — calm, simple, no text or labels.
